operations.target: gh help reference; gh --help; gh repo edit --help (separate argv calls)
operations.description: Discover local CLI help without running discovered commands.
operations.trigger: github-explorer --list-commands, Reload catalog or Repo settings
operations.retryPolicy: No automatic retries; correct the error and reload manually.
operations.observability: In-memory TUI status or CLI stderr; no persistent log.

remediation.missing-executable: Install GitHub CLI and check PATH.
remediation.help-failed: Inspect the displayed CLI error; repair local gh configuration.
remediation.timeout: Check the local gh installation, then retry explicitly.

operations.target: gh repo view identity; gh api --method GET repository metadata, trees and blobs
operations.description: Read GitHub default-branch files, previews and current repository settings.
operations.trigger: Panel entry, Refresh files, file selection and Repo settings
operations.retryPolicy: No automatic retry; refresh explicitly after resolving the cause.
operations.observability: In-memory file list, preview, settings form or error status; no persistence.

remediation.read-failed: Check repository context, gh authentication, permissions and API limits.
remediation.cancelled: Select a file or refresh the repository to start another read.
remediation.truncated: Use gh directly for a response exceeding the app's bounded capture.
remediation.invalid-json: Inspect the CLI installation and GitHub API response.

operations.target: User-confirmed gh or git argv and their child processes
operations.description: Run a confirmed command with bounded output and cancellation.
operations.warning: Commands, aliases, extensions and Git hooks can change local and remote data.
operations.trigger: Run, captured shortcut or Repo settings / Review changes, then confirm
operations.retryPolicy: Never automatically replay commands; side effects may have completed.
operations.observability: In-memory output, exit status, cancellation and timeout indicators.

remediation.invalid-input: Correct argv, working directory, repository or timeout.
remediation.spawn-error: Check gh/git installation and working directory permissions.
remediation.nonzero-exit: Read the captured error and verify side effects before retrying.
remediation.cancelled: Verify remote state; Stop cannot undo completed actions.
remediation.timeout: Verify remote state before explicitly retrying.
remediation.truncated: Use narrower gh output options; retained output is bounded.

operations.target: User-confirmed gh or git argv in the user's terminal
operations.description: Suspend the host TUI for an interactive command.
operations.warning: Commands can prompt, write files, change GitHub data or run extensions.
operations.trigger: Terminal or interactive shortcut, then confirm the command preview
operations.retryPolicy: No automatic retries; inspect side effects before retrying manually.
operations.observability: Terminal output and in-memory exit status; no capture or log file.

remediation.spawn-error: Check executable and working directory access.
remediation.nonzero-exit: Inspect terminal diagnostics; verify side effects before retrying.
remediation.interrupted: Ctrl-C returns 130; verify remote state before retrying.
remediation.suspend-unsupported: Use a host supporting App.suspend() for terminal mode.

operations.target: Textual App.copy_to_clipboard and the user's terminal clipboard
operations.description: Copy the last captured output only after an explicit button press.
operations.warning: The clipboard may retain sensitive captured output outside the app.
operations.retryPolicy: No automatic retries; terminal clipboard support varies.
operations.observability: In-memory copy status; clipboard receipt is not verified.

remediation.clipboard-unavailable: Check terminal clipboard support and select text manually.

audit.reason: Local TUI has no service dashboard or datastore. Persistent command logs conflict with the project's privacy contract. This is metadata, not a dispatcher.
audit.remediation: Human guidance only; keys classify outcomes, not runtime error codes.
audit.verification: The app does not own a datastore. gh may change external state; the user must verify those changes before retrying.
